d: Can the cleaners help to make 200 year old Castle Ellen habitable enough for the owners grandchildren to stay? (S1 E04)

Programme one features Tapeley Park, the Queen Anne home of 53-year-old Hector and his bull terrier, Wayne. Originally destined to inherit the world famous opera house, Glydnebourne, Hector opted instead to take on the familys Devon retreat. (S2 E01)

83 year old Ursula Leslie currently lives in Tarbet House, the family home for 300 years. While the main rooms on the ground floor retain their original splendour, the rest is a dumping ground. (S2 E03)

The cleaners head to the Guynd, a Regency mansion in North East Scotland. Will owner John help them clear out the chainsaws, newspapers and mousedroppings in time for its grand highland gathering? (S2 E04)

The cleaners are heading to the Welsh hills and Brithdir Hall, home to Jeremy, 55, his son Thomas, 15, and Clayton the spaniel. Will Jeremy part with his clutter and can the cleaners revive the Hall? (S2 E05)

The cleaners head to Poundisford Lodge, home to Josephine, 83, an acclaimed writer of ghost stories. Can the cleaners manage to persuade Josephine to let go of the past enough to clear out the junk? (S2 E06)
Richard Searle meets Christopher Sylvester, a retired antiques dealer whose stone Victorian cottage has been overwhelmed by 15 years' worth of collectibles and bric-a-brac.
Denise is taking four days out of her own cleaning regime to help 82-year-old retired British Aerospace engineer Frank from Chipping Sodbury.
